# Arch Tools
> The first API platform built for autonomous agent payments.
> 63 production-ready tools. One API key. USDC on Base or Polygon via x402 or Stripe.
> Base URL: https://archtools.dev
> Docs: https://archtools.dev/docs
> OpenAPI: https://archtools.dev/openapi.json
> MCP SSE: https://archtools.dev/mcp/sse
> Discovery: https://archtools.dev/v1/tools
> Agent Card: https://archtools.dev/.well-known/agent.json
> GitHub: https://github.com/Deesmo/Arch-AI-Tools

## Authentication
All tool endpoints require an API key:
  Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY

Get a free key (100 credits — 25 instant, 75 on email verify) at https://archtools.dev/signup

## x402 Autonomous Payment (no key required)
AI agents can pay per-call with USDC on Base via the x402 protocol.
No API key, no signup, no human credit card needed.
Discovery: https://archtools.dev/.well-known/x402
Protocol: https://x402.org

## Credit Pricing
- Starter Pack: 3,000 credits — $9 ($0.0030/credit)
- Pro Pack: 25,000 credits — $49 ($0.00196/credit)
- Business Pack: 125,000 credits — $199 ($0.00159/credit)

## Tool Categories

### AI & NLP
- [AI Generate](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/ai-generate): AI-powered text generation using Claude (20 credits)
- [AI Oracle](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/ai-oracle): AI reasoning engine with standard and deep analysis modes (25 credits)
- [Workflow Agent](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/workflow-agent): Multi-step autonomous AI agent pipeline (25 credits)
- [Session Create](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/session-create): Create a persistent AI conversation session (5 credits)
- [Session Message](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/session-message): Send a message in an existing AI session (20 credits)
- [Summarize](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/summarize): Summarize text in multiple styles: paragraph, bullets, tldr, headline, executive (10 credits)
- [Sentiment Analysis](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/sentiment-analysis): Analyze text sentiment: positive/negative/neutral with score and emotion detection (8 credits)
- [Extract Entities](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/extract-entities): Named entity recognition: people, organizations, locations, dates, money, and more (8 credits)
- [Language Detect](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/language-detect): Detect the language of any text with confidence score and script identification (3 credits)
- [Regex Generate](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/regex-generate): Generate regular expressions from plain English with explanations and test results (8 credits)
- [PII Detect](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/pii-detect): Detect and optionally redact PII: names, emails, SSNs, credit cards, API keys, and more (10 credits)

### Search & Research
- [Search Web](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/search-web): Search the web and return structured results (Tavily/Serper or DuckDuckGo fallback) (5 credits)
- [Web Search](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/web-search): Real-time web search with AI-synthesized answer (14 credits)
- [Semantic Search](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/semantic-search): AI-powered semantic search across web content (8 credits)
- [News Search](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/news-search): Search for recent news articles on any topic. Returns title, URL, description, source, and publication date from Brave News, Tavily, or Serper. (12 credits)
- [Fact Check](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/fact-check): Verify the accuracy of a claim. Returns verdict (TRUE/FALSE/MIXED/UNVERIFIED/MISLEADING), confidence score, summary, and supporting/contradicting evidence with sources. (14 credits)
- [Research Report](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/research-report): Generate a structured AI research report on any topic. Searches multiple sources and synthesizes findings into executive summary, key findings, and conclusion with citations. (40 credits)

### Web & Scraping
- [Web Scrape](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/web-scrape): Scrape and extract content from websites with optional CSS selector (5 credits)
- [Extract Page](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/extract-page): Fetch a webpage and return clean text, metadata, and links (5 credits)
- [Browser Task](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/browser-task): Headless browser automation (click/type/extract) via Playwright — SSRF hardened (10 credits)
- [Screenshot Capture](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/screenshot-capture): Capture page metadata and screenshot URL for any public URL (10 credits)
- [HTML To Markdown](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/html-to-markdown): Convert HTML or any URL to clean Markdown (3 credits)
- [RSS Parse](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/rss-parse): Fetch and parse RSS or Atom feeds into clean structured JSON (4 credits)
- [Extract PDF](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/extract-pdf): Extract text and tables from a PDF (6 credits)
- [Extract Metadata](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/extract-metadata): Extract metadata from text or URLs (word count, OG tags, headers, etc.) (3 credits)
- [URL Shorten](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/url-shorten): Shorten any URL via TinyURL (1 credit)
- [Webhook Send](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/webhook-send): POST a JSON payload to any webhook URL (2 credits)

### Crypto
- [Crypto Price](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/crypto-price): Real-time price, 24h change, market cap, and volume for any cryptocurrency (1 credit)
- [Crypto OHLCV](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/crypto-ohlcv): OHLCV candlestick data for any crypto over 1-90 days (2 credits)
- [Crypto Market Cap](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/crypto-market-cap): Top N cryptocurrencies by market cap with price, volume, and 24h change (1 credit)
- [Crypto Fear Greed](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/crypto-fear-greed): Crypto Fear & Greed Index with historical data (1 credit)
- [Crypto Sentiment](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/crypto-sentiment): Community sentiment, social stats, and price momentum for any cryptocurrency (2 credits)
- [Crypto News](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/crypto-news): Latest crypto news headlines. Filter by token symbol (2 credits)
- [Token Lookup](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/token-lookup): Search for any token by name or ticker, returns CoinGecko IDs (1 credit)

### Media & Design
- [Design Create](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/design-create): Generate designs and images via DALL-E 3 (50 credits)
- [Generate Image](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/generate-image): Generate images from text prompts via DALL-E 3 (1024×1024, 1792×1024, 1024×1792). (50 credits)
- [Image Generate](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/image-generate): Generate SVG images from text prompts via Claude (30 credits)
- [Image Remove BG](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/image-remove-bg): Remove background from any image (350 credits)
- [Video Generate](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/video-generate): Generate short video clips from text prompts (700 credits)
- [OCR Extract](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/ocr-extract): Extract text from images or screenshots using AI vision (base64 or URL input) (12 credits)
- [Text To Speech](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/text-to-speech): Convert text to natural-sounding audio via ElevenLabs. Returns base64-encoded MP3. (25 credits)
- [Transcribe Audio](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/transcribe-audio): Transcribe audio files to text via OpenAI Whisper. Supports 100+ languages. (25 credits)

### Data & Validation
- [Validate Data](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/validate-data): Validate JSON data against a JSON Schema (1 credit)
- [Convert Format](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/convert-format): Convert data between JSON, YAML, CSV, and XML formats (2 credits)
- [JSONPath Query](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/jsonpath-query): Run JSONPath expressions against any JSON payload (1 credit)
- [Diff Text](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/diff-text): Compare two text strings and return differences in unified, word, char, or JSON format (2 credits)
- [Transform Text](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/transform-text): Transform text: uppercase, lowercase, trim, reverse, slug, title, camel, snake, base64 (3 credits)
- [Readability Score](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/readability-score): Compute Flesch-Kincaid readability, grade level, word count, and read time (2 credits)
- [QR Code](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/qr-code): Generate QR codes from text or URLs (PNG data URL or SVG) (2 credits)
- [Barcode Generate](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/barcode-generate): Generate Code128 barcodes as SVG (2 credits)

### Network & Identity
- [IP Lookup](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/ip-lookup): Geolocate any IP address — country, city, timezone, ISP, VPN/proxy detection (2 credits)
- [WHOIS Lookup](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/whois-lookup): Look up domain registration info: registrar, created/expires dates, nameservers, status (3 credits)
- [Domain Check](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/domain-check): Check domain availability via RDAP (2 credits)
- [Check Domain](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/check-domain): Check if a domain is available or registered via RDAP. No API key needed. (2 credits)
- [Phone Validate](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/phone-validate): Parse and validate phone numbers in any format — E.164, carrier type, country (2 credits)
- [Email Verify](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/email-verify): Deep email validation: syntax, MX record check, disposable domain detection (3 credits)
- [Email Find](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/email-find): Find email addresses for a person at a company domain (110 credits)

### Communication
- [Email Send](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/email-send): Send transactional emails via Resend (3 credits)
- [Send Email](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/send-email): Send transactional emails via Resend — plain text or HTML. (3 credits)

### Utilities
- [Generate Hash](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/generate-hash): Generate cryptographic hashes (sha256, sha512, md5, sha1) (1 credit)
- [Generate UUID](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/generate-uuid): Generate UUIDs (v1/v4), secure random tokens, and API-key-format strings (1 credit)
- [Currency Convert](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/currency-convert): Convert between currencies using real-time exchange rates (170+ currencies) (2 credits)
- [Timezone Convert](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/timezone-convert): Convert a datetime between any two IANA timezones (1 credit)

## Workflows
POST /v1/workflows/run — Execute multiple tools in sequence (up to 8 steps)

## Discovery Endpoints (no auth required)
- GET /v1/tools — Full tool list with schemas
- GET /v1/discover — All tools + pricing + payment info
- GET /openapi.json — OpenAPI 3.1 specification
- GET /health — Service health + dependency status
- GET /.well-known/x402 — x402 payment discovery
- GET /.well-known/agent.json — A2A Agent Card
- GET /.well-known/ai-plugin.json — ChatGPT plugin manifest
- GET /llms.txt — This file
- GET /llms-full.txt — Complete documentation

## MCP Integration
- SSE: https://archtools.dev/mcp/sse
- Streamable HTTP: https://archtools.dev/mcp/mcp
- Registry: io.github.Deesmo/arch-tools-mcp
- Compatible: Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, any MCP client
